system.description: When you roll on a task you're trained in (other than an attack or defense task) and your roll is less than a 12, treat the roll as a 12. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Enabler. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 15.
